title: NOMOS Chain Verification Response
description: Response body from POST /verify (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §4.4, §6.2, §7.3). Exactly one of seven decisions. The three chain-authenticity failures (ISSUER_NOT_RECOGNIZED, KEY_REVOKED, SEAL_INVALID) and the rule-evaluation outcome (DENIED) MUST remain distinguishable — collapsing 'the issuer was never established' into 'the rules said no' is a nonconformant implementation (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §10.1).

leaf_kid.description: Present only when decision is ALLOWED — the artifact's own resolved signing key id.

path.description: Present only when decision is ALLOWED — the resolved kid path from root to leaf.

reason.description: Overloaded by decision, disclosed rather than hidden (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §8.2): when decision is ISSUER_NOT_RECOGNIZED, one of a fixed set of short codes (no_certificate_for_root | chain_broken | cycle | bad_signature | expired | not_yet_valid) — see reason for that case below. When decision is AUTHORIZED, DENIED, or ESCALATED, a full human-readable explanation from rule evaluation instead. A future revision should consider splitting these into distinct field names.

rule.description: Present when decision is AUTHORIZED, DENIED, or ESCALATED — the rule id that decided it, if any.

missing_inputs.description: Present when decision is ESCALATED — the fields the artifact's rules still need.

obligations.description: May accompany AUTHORIZED, DENIED, or ESCALATED — notify/log/flag-style duties, same vocabulary as NOMOS-SPEC-005 §1's public-query response.

revoked_kid.description: Present only when decision is KEY_REVOKED — the kid of the specific key found revoked.

detail.description: Human-readable detail for ISSUER_NOT_RECOGNIZED, KEY_REVOKED, SEAL_INVALID, or MALFORMED.

examples.detail: Chain breaks after kid 40ZaXrnpntaoD4dn — no certificate continues it toward the artifact's signing key.
